description: Find go-to-market software by the job it does. Returns published listings with page and markdown URLs to cite.

category.description: Category or subcategory slug from list_categories or a tool page.

has_api.description: Only tools that do (true) or do not (false) have a public API.

has_mcp.description: Only tools that do (true) or do not (false) ship an MCP server.

offset.description: Number of results to skip, for paging. Use meta.offset plus meta.limit from the previous call.

query.description: The job in plain words, for example "cold email sending".

name: search_tools
title: Search GTM tools
